verdict: Incyte's revenue grew 14% to $1.56B on strong drug sales — but a one-time $1.23B research charge for the Vega Therapeutics acquisition turned the quarter into a $785M paper loss.

segments.name: Product sales
segments.note: Incyte's own medicines: Jakafi ($827M), Opzelura cream ($255M, +36%) and a hematology/oncology portfolio ($235M, +38%).

segments.name: Product royalty revenues
segments.note: Royalties from partners who sell drugs built on Incyte's discoveries, such as Novartis's Jakavi.

segments.name: Milestone & contract revenues
segments.note: Payments from collaboration partners when research programs hit agreed milestones.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Drug research — swollen this quarter by a one-time $1.23B charge for acquiring Vega Therapeutics' research. Without it, R&D was about $0.55B, up 11%.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling the medicines and running the company.

opex.name: Contingent consideration loss
opex.note: A $1M increase in the estimated future payments owed on a past acquisition.

otherDetail: Interest income of $32M on Incyte's cash pile, less a $13M loss on equity investments, $1M of interest expense, plus $1M of other income — a net $19M gain.

takeaways.title: Sales growth is broadening
takeaways.text: Jakafi grew just 4% to $827M, but Opzelura jumped 36% to $255M and hematology/oncology products 38% to $235M — the business beyond Jakafi is doing the growing.

takeaways.title: One charge explains the loss
takeaways.text: GAAP R&D of $1.79B includes a one-time $1.23B in-process R&D charge for buying Vega Therapeutics. Excluding it, R&D rose 11% and the quarter was solidly profitable before the charge.

takeaways.title: Sales guidance raised
takeaways.text: Incyte lifted its full-year 2026 net sales outlook to $5.21–5.30B, raising the ranges for Opzelura and for hematology/oncology products.

oneTimers: A $1.23B one-time in-process research & development charge for the acquisition of Vega Therapeutics sits inside R&D — it is a purchase price for research, not a quarterly running cost. GAAP net loss was $785M; even the company's non-GAAP figures show a $731M loss because the charge is only partly adjusted out.
footerNote: Amounts are rounded to $M from Incyte's thousands-denominated statement; R&D absorbs a $1M rounding difference so the lines add exactly.
